SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES 
 
September 10, 2026 
 
A Special Meeting of the Council of the City of Vancouver was held on Thursday, September 
10, 2026, at 10:00 am, in the Council Chamber, Third Floor, City Hall, for the purpose of 
considering and enacting the By-law entitled "2027 Real Property Tax Interest on Arrears." This 
Special Council meeting was convened in person and via electronic means as authorized by 
Part 14 of the Procedure By-law. 
 
PRESENT: 
Mayor Ken Sim  
Councillor Lisa Dominato 
Councillor Pete Fry 
Councillor Sarah Kirby-Yung 
Councillor Mike Klassen 
Councillor Lucy Maloney 
Councillor Peter Meiszner 
Councillor Brian Montague 
Councillor Sean Orr 
Councillor Lenny Zhou 
 
ABSENT 
Councillor Rebecca Bligh 
 
CITY MANAGER’S OFFICE: 
Donny van Dyk, City Manager 
 
CITY CLERK’S OFFICE: 
Andrew Aguilar, Deputy City Clerk 
David Yim, Meeting Coordinator 
 
WELCOME 
 
The Mayor acknowledged we are on the unceded homelands of the Musqueam, Squamish, and 
Tsleil-Waututh People. We thank them for having cared for this land and look forward to working 
with them in partnership as we continue to build this great city together. 
 
The Mayor also recognized the immense contributions of the City of Vancouver’s team 
members who work hard every day to help make our city an incredible place to live, work, and 
play. 
 
 

Special Council Meeting 
Minutes, Thursday, September 10, 2026 
2 
 
 
1. 
2027 Real Property Tax Interest on Arrears 
 
Staff from Finance and Supply Chain Management responded to questions. 
 
MOVED by Councillor Klassen 
SECONDED by Councillor Zhou 
 
THAT Council enact the by-law listed on the agenda for this meeting as number 1 and 
authorize the Mayor and City Clerk to sign and seal the enacted by-law. 
 
CARRIED UNANIMOUSLY  
 
2027 Real Property Tax Interest on Arrears (By-law No. 14822) 
 
 
ADJOURNMENT 
 
MOVED by Councillor Klassen 
SECONDED by Councillor Zhou 
 
THAT the meeting be adjourned. 
 
CARRIED UNANIMOUSLY 
 
 
The Special Council adjourned at 10:05 am. 
 
 
* * * * *

agenda_briefs.title: Proposed: Vancouver 2027 by-law sets interest rate on overdue property taxes
agenda_briefs.summary: Council will vote on a by-law setting the 2027 interest rate on delinquent (overdue) property taxes at 8.45% per annum, compounded annually. If approved, this rate applies to all real property taxes that become delinquent after December 31, 2026. Property owners who pay late in 2027 will owe this interest on top of the unpaid taxes.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Watch for the council vote on September 10, 2026, and prepare for the 8.45% annual interest rate on any 2027 property taxes paid late.

minutes_briefs.title: Council enacted 2027 Real Property Tax Interest on Arrears By-law No. 14822
minutes_briefs.summary: Council voted unanimously to enact the 2027 Real Property Tax Interest on Arrears By-law No. 14822. The by-law sets the interest rate the City of Vancouver will charge on unpaid property taxes for the 2027 tax year. Council also authorized the Mayor and City Clerk to sign and seal the by-law, making it official. Property owners who do not pay their taxes on time will owe interest at this rate.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Mark your 2027 property tax due date and pay on time to avoid interest charges under By-law No. 14822.
